threads.body: The new comment uses the term "side-level routing", but the rest of the file consistently describes this as "per-PR routing" / "routing buckets". Using a unique term here is ambiguous and makes the intent harder to follow.

replies.body:
Fixed in https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai/commit/22304e45faebf888b14cdd8ac2751cacd4e17438.

Reworded the comment to say the synthetic PR conversation contributes to the PR routing bucket but is not a reviewer-owned discussion thread for badges.
